candidate.content: In an ALFWorld kitchen environment where the target object (egg) is not found in semantically likely containers (fridge, cabinets, drawers), a systematic traversal of remaining receptacles including non-food storage locations (garbagecan) successfully located and acquired the target. The search policy involved checking high-probability food storage first, then expanding to general surfaces and finally waste disposal units.
candidate.scope: ALFWorld pick-and-place tasks involving hidden food items; specifically applies when initial semantic priors for food storage fail, requiring broader spatial exploration.

direct_grounding.semantic_fact: The agent prioritized 'go to fridge_1' as the first action after initialization, consistent with searching for food items.
Opening fridge_1 revealed cup_2, mug_2, mug_1, pan_2, and potato_1, but no egg, necessitating further search.
The agent proceeded to inspect cabinet_6, continuing the search through enclosed storage units.
Cabinet_6 was empty, confirming the need to check other cabinets.
Cabinet_5 was also empty upon inspection.
Cabinet_2 contained only bowl_1, failing to yield the target egg.
Cabinet_1 contained cup_1, glassbottle_2, and pan_1, but no egg.
Countertop_3 contained various items like bread_2 and lettuce_1, but no egg.
Countertop_2 contained utensils and bread_1, but no egg.
Drawer_3 contained fork_2 and peppershaker_2, but no egg.
Drawer_2 contained saltshaker_1, but no egg.
Drawer_1 contained spatula_1, but no egg.
Upon reaching garbagecan_1, the observation explicitly listed 'egg_1' among the visible objects, indicating the target was located in a non-standard storage location.
The agent successfully executed 'take egg_1 from garbagecan_1', completing the acquisition phase.

minimal_global_context: The task instruction was to 'put a cool egg in sinkbasin', implying the egg needed to be found first.
The environment contained multiple receptacle types: cabinets, drawers, countertops, fridge, microwave, toaster, stoveburners, shelves, sinkbasin, coffeemachine, and garbagecan.
The search order followed a pattern of enclosed storage (fridge/cabinets/drawers) -> open surfaces (countertops) -> miscellaneous/appliance locations -> waste disposal.
